title: TeamViewer security advisory (AV26-1093)
description: As of October 27, 2026, TeamViewer is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
TeamViewer Full Client & Host (Windows)
	Prior to 15.83

TeamViewer Full Client & Host (Linux)
	Prior to 15.83

TeamViewer Full Client & Host (macOS)
	Prior to 15.83

TeamViewer Host (Windows, Linux, macOS)
	Prior to 15.83

TeamViewer Remote Control App (Android)
	Prior to 15.8.3
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
